meta.docSubtitle: Scoping supplement for your MuleSoft engagement
meta.source: Discovery sessions with AgileMind team (Apr 28 + May 8, 2026)

bizContext.snapshot: Agile Mind is a K–12 educational curriculum publisher that develops and licenses math and science programs (grades 6–12), including Intensified Algebra and Intensified Mathematics. The company sells both digital access licenses and physical print materials (Student Activity Books, Teacher Books) to school districts nationwide. Revenue is driven by multi-year district agreements, with the print procurement and fulfillment cycle peaking April–August ahead of back-to-school start dates.

journeyCards.label: Connected
journeyCards.headline: Agreement-to-Invoice Without Spreadsheets
journeyCards.body: Automate the handoff from Salesforce agreements to QuickBooks invoices and sync inventory data from Excel/QuickBooks into Salesforce. Crystal stops re-keying. Holly sees live inventory. Maria sees payment status without running QB reports manually.

journeyCards.label: Automated
journeyCards.headline: Demand-Driven Procurement Planning
journeyCards.body: With connected pipeline data and live inventory in one place, trigger automated purchase recommendations when open opportunity demand exceeds available stock. Automate invoice due date reminders and run inventory shortage projections by title without Holly building manual demand worksheets.

journeyCards.label: Agentic
journeyCards.headline: AI-Powered Inventory Optimization
journeyCards.body: An AI agent monitors the full order-to-fulfillment pipeline — reading opportunity stages, inventory levels, and historical sell-through — to recommend optimal print run quantities for each title, flagging overstock risk and projected shorts weeks before the production deadline.

p0Blockers.title: QuickBooks Version
p0Blockers.body: Online vs Desktop/Enterprise not confirmed. QBO = native MuleSoft connector. Desktop = completely different architecture (no REST API). Must confirm before any architecture. Owner: Maria Gonzalez-Pettway.

p0Blockers.title: QBO Plan Tier
p0Blockers.body: Inventory tracking requires Plus or Advanced plan. Simple Start / Essentials have no inventory API. Must confirm plan tier. Owner: Maria Gonzalez-Pettway.

p0Blockers.title: Salesforce Inventory__c Object
p0Blockers.body: Custom Inventory object does not exist in Salesforce. Must be designed and created by Chloe's engineering team before UC3/UC4 can be built. DataSkate will provide a field specification. Owner: Chloe (Engineering Director).

p0Blockers.title: QB OAuth Consent
p0Blockers.body: The QB Company Admin (Maria or Linda) must authorize DataSkate API access via a one-time OAuth consent flow before any integration testing. Owner: Maria Gonzalez-Pettway / Linda.

sections.title: Use Cases
sections.bodyHtml:
UC-1 Salesforce Agreement → QuickBooks Invoice (Event-Driven)
  • Triggered when a Salesforce Agreement status changes to Approved or Active
  • Creates a new invoice in QuickBooks Online for an existing QB customer account
  • Maps Agreement line items (programs, quantities, pricing) to QB Invoice line items
  • Returns the QB Invoice number, invoice date, and due date back to Agreement__c (field: SF_QB_InvoiceId__c)
  • Due date rule: Jan–Mar orders → due July/August; summer orders → due 30 days from invoice creation
Q1.1

Which exact Salesforce Agreement Status picklist value should trigger invoice creation in QuickBooks? Both “Approved” and “Active” were mentioned in sessions — confirm the exact trigger value.

Q1.2

What is the exact Salesforce API name of the Agreement custom object? Crystal confirmed it exists as a custom object.

Q1.3

If a QB invoice already exists for an Agreement (re-approval or duplicate trigger scenario), should the integration skip / update / create a new invoice?

  • Skip — leave existing QB invoice unchanged
  • Update existing QB invoice
  • Create a new invoice regardless
Q1.4

Confirm the invoice due date rules for both scenarios:
a) Orders placed January–March: due date = which specific month/day (e.g. July 31)?
b) Summer orders placed after April 1: due date = 30 calendar days from invoice creation date?
Crystal and Maria confirmed both rules in sessions.

Q1.5

Multi-year agreements — prepaid scenario: full contract invoiced in Year 1, Years 2/3 Agreements are $0. When Year 1 triggers, should the integration include Year 2/3 lines at $0 on the QB invoice, or only Year 1 amount?

  • Year 1 amount only
  • Include $0 lines for Year 2/3
Q1.6

Multi-year agreements — pay-per-year: each year is a separate Agreement. Should each confirmed annual Agreement create its own separate QB invoice? Abby Dawson: “treated similarly to regular year-to-year opportunities.”

  • Yes — separate QB invoice per annual Agreement
  • Consolidate — describe below
Q1.7

Which Salesforce Agreement fields should be updated after the QB invoice is created (sync-back)? From sessions: SF_QB_InvoiceId__c, invoice date, due date, and open balance were mentioned.

In Scope
  • Event-driven Agreement→Invoice creation
  • QB Invoice number + dates written back to Salesforce Agreement
  • Due date logic (early orders vs. summer orders)
  • Multi-year handling per confirmed rules
Assumed Pre-Exists
  • Agreement__c exists as a custom object in Salesforce
  • SF_QB_InvoiceId__c External ID field created before development
  • QB Customer records already exist matching Salesforce Accounts
Out of Scope
  • Creating QB Customer records from Salesforce Accounts
  • Collections follow-up and escalation notes (remains manual)
UC-2 QuickBooks Payment Status → Salesforce Agreement (Scheduled Sync)
  • Scheduled nightly poll of QuickBooks Online Invoices and Payments
  • Syncs QB Invoice status (Open / Paid / Partially Paid), open balance amount, and payment date back to Salesforce Agreement
  • Crystal currently updates these fields manually after running QB reports
Q2.1

What is the desired polling schedule for the QB payment sync?

  • Once nightly (2 AM CT)
  • Multiple times per day
  • Other — specify below
Q2.2

Which Salesforce fields should be updated when QB payment status changes? Please confirm API names or corrections. Invoice status, open balance, and payment date were mentioned in sessions.

Q2.3

When QB shows a “Partially Paid” invoice, should the open balance in Salesforce update immediately on each partial payment, or only update when fully paid?

  • Update on every partial payment
  • Update only on full payment
Q2.4

Should the integration log each payment event as a Salesforce Activity/Task, or only update field values on the Agreement record?

  • Update fields only
  • Log Activity/Task + update fields
In Scope
  • Nightly scheduled poll of QB Invoices + Payments
  • Sync of payment status, open balance, and payment date to Salesforce Agreement
Assumed Pre-Exists
  • QB Invoice ID stored in SF_QB_InvoiceId__c (written by UC1)
  • QB Company Admin has completed OAuth consent
Out of Scope
  • Payment reminders, overdue alerts, or collections escalation (remains manual)
  • Creating or modifying QB payments from Salesforce
UC-3 Excel / Google Sheets Inventory → Salesforce Inventory Object (Scheduled)
  • Holly Wale maintains an inventory demand worksheet with: product title, ISBN, quantity-on-hand, committed quantity, available quantity, unit cost, and buffer percentage
  • Integration pushes this data into a new custom Salesforce Inventory object (Inventory__c)
  • Provides Salesforce-based inventory dashboard for all teams
P0 Blocker The Salesforce custom Inventory object (Inventory__c) does not yet exist. Chloe’s IT team must design and create it before this flow can be built. DataSkate will provide the field specification — see Section 3.3.
Q3.1

Is Holly’s inventory worksheet a Google Sheet (hosted at sheets.google.com) or a local Excel file? Holly said “Google Sheets I own” on May 8 and “Excel” on the AE call — this distinction changes the connector architecture entirely.

  • Google Sheet (sheets.google.com)
  • Local Excel file on PC
  • Excel on OneDrive or SharePoint
Q3.2

How often is Holly’s worksheet updated? Is it updated continuously throughout the week, or only at specific intervals?

  • Continuously (real-time updates)
  • Daily — end of day
  • Weekly
  • Other — specify below
Q3.3

What is the maximum number of rows (ISBN/title combinations) in Holly’s worksheet at peak season?

Q3.4

Should this flow replace all Salesforce Inventory records on each run (full refresh), or upsert only changed rows (incremental update by ISBN)?

  • Full refresh — replace all records each run
  • Upsert by ISBN — update changed rows only
  • Other — specify below
Q3.5

If QB is the primary source of record for inventory (UC4 provides raw QOH from QB), what is the intended role of UC3 after UC4 goes live? From sessions: Kailash proposed QB as primary source; Maria and Holly agreed. UC3 may be Holly’s demand planning overlay rather than raw QOH data.

  • UC3 continues as ongoing demand overlay (different data from UC4)
  • UC3 is initial load only — UC4 takes over QOH after go-live
  • Other — specify below
In Scope
  • Scheduled sync of inventory data from Holly’s worksheet into Salesforce Inventory__c
  • Upsert by ISBN; committed/available inventory separation
Assumed Pre-Exists
  • Salesforce Inventory__c object created by Chloe’s team with aligned field names
  • Holly’s sheet shared with DataSkate service account (if Google Sheets)
Out of Scope
  • Salesforce Inventory object design (client-side prerequisite)
  • Modifying Holly’s worksheet format
  • Inventory valuation or cost accounting
UC-4 QuickBooks Inventory Items → Salesforce Inventory Object (Scheduled Nightly)
  • Scheduled nightly pull from QuickBooks Online Item objects (type = Inventory)
  • Syncs quantity-on-hand from QB (auto-decremented when invoices are created) into Salesforce Inventory__c
  • QB is the source-of-record for raw QOH; UC4 surfaces that data in Salesforce for dashboards and reporting
P0 Blocker QuickBooks version MUST be confirmed as QBO (cloud/online) before this flow can be scoped. QuickBooks Desktop/Enterprise has no REST API and requires a completely different architecture.
P0 Blocker QBO inventory tracking requires the Plus or Advanced plan. Essentials and Simple Start plans have no inventory API. Please confirm your current plan tier.
Q4.1

[P0] Is your QuickBooks the cloud-hosted version at quickbooks.intuit.com (QuickBooks Online), or is it installed on a local server or PC (QuickBooks Desktop/Enterprise)? Strong session indicators point to QBO, but version was never explicitly confirmed.

  • QuickBooks Online (cloud — quickbooks.intuit.com)
  • QuickBooks Desktop (local install)
  • QuickBooks Enterprise
Q4.2

[P0 — if QBO confirmed] What QuickBooks Online plan is AgileMind on? Inventory tracking via the QBO API is only available on Plus or Advanced plans.

  • Simple Start
  • Essentials
  • Plus
  • Advanced
Q4.3

Has a QuickBooks Company Admin (Maria or Linda) already registered a developer application in the Intuit Developer Portal, or will DataSkate walk through OAuth app registration with you?

  • Already registered
  • Not yet — we will do this when DataSkate requests
  • Unknown
Q4.4

What is the desired nightly sync schedule for UC4 (QB Items → Salesforce Inventory)?

Q4.5

Should UC4 sync all QB Inventory Items (all ISBNs/titles), or only items belonging to a specific QB class, category, or list?

  • All inventory items
  • Filter by QB class or category — specify below
In Scope
  • Nightly scheduled pull of QB Inventory Items (type=Inventory)
  • Sync of quantity-on-hand to Salesforce Inventory__c by ISBN
Assumed Pre-Exists
  • Salesforce Inventory__c object exists (same prerequisite as UC3)

internalFlags.bodyHtml:
1
Auth model: Salesforce = OAuth JWT (service account). QB = OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code with refresh token stored in CloudHub Secrets Manager. QB realmId stored in Secrets Manager — not in property files.
2
QB update pattern: QBO API has no PUT/PATCH. All updates via POST with full object + current SyncToken (retrieved via GET immediately before each POST). See FK-017.
3
QB token refresh (FK-017): Access tokens expire hard at 60 minutes. MuleSoft QBO connector handles refresh automatically when configured with refresh token. For batch flows exceeding 60 min, implement 401-detect → refresh → retry wrapper.
4
QB version gate: If Q4.1 answer is anything other than “QuickBooks Online (cloud)” — STOP and escalate to Kailash immediately. QB Desktop requires QBXML + Windows Web Connector — completely different architecture. See FK-020.
5
Google Sheets: Use service-account auth (no user OAuth prompt for unattended flow). Sheet must be shared with DataSkate service account email before development begins.
6
Salesforce trigger for UC1: Prefer Platform Event or Change Data Capture (CDC) on Agreement__c over polling. Requires Chloe to confirm CDC is enabled in their Salesforce org (Q5.4).
7
ISBN lookup table: Custom Metadata Type recommended. Supports runtime update without code deployment. Kailash proposed; Maria agreed. Kailash will send field spec to Chloe.
8
Inventory committed/available: Must be calculated in the integration layer or Salesforce (QOH - committed = available). Committed quantity is derived from open Agreement line items — not directly available from QB.
9
Back-to-school deployment risk: Go-live target July 15, 2026. Back-to-school fulfillment peaks July–August. If anything slips past July 1, recommend rescheduling to September. Cutover: Tuesday early AM CT with Crystal and Maria on standby.
10
P0 escalation path: All 4 P0 blockers (QB version, QBO plan tier, SF Inventory__c creation, QB OAuth consent) must be resolved in the intake questionnaire response before any architecture work begins. If any P0 is unresolved by requirements kickoff, the project start date must slip.
